entries.note: Page: 'Our emergency care services are available round the clock', 'For Emergency Call 24/7'. 24 h applies to the emergency service, not the regular hours.

entries.name: Creekside Vet Clinic

entries.name: The Cat Specialist Veterinary Clinic
entries.address: RAA Building 1, Shop 1, Hessa St.
entries.duty: Cats. Clinic hours daily (8 am-9 pm weekdays, 8 am-8 pm weekend). Emergency line +971 54 306 5423. Call ahead.
entries.note: Heading '24/7 Emergency Vet Services', 'accessible daily, 365 days a year', but footer hours are daytime only; 24/7 claim unclear. Cats only (small_animals true). Set to not 24 h by orchestrator 2026-11-10: 24/7 wording does not clearly apply to this branch/clinic hours.

entries.name: The City Vet Clinic (Al Wasl)
entries.address: Al Wasl Road, corner Al Manara, Villa 881
entries.duty: Al Wasl branch 7 am-9 pm. Emergency line +971 50 366 5985. Call ahead.
entries.note: Emergency page: facilities 'throughout Dubai are prepared to handle urgent medical situations 24 hours a day, 7 days a week' (no branch named). Al Ain branch listed on the locations page without address/phone, skipped. Set to not 24 h by orchestrator 2026-11-10: 24/7 wording does not clearly apply to this branch/clinic hours.

Not opened or unreachable: australianvet.com and skyvet.vetpms.com (redirect), happy-pets-vet-clinic.com (inactive domain), Al Ain university vet hospital, Fluffy and Zoko (Ajman), Vets Fur Pets, Amity, Pet Point (Dubai), Pets Oasis Al Ain.
